findings.result: The 40 cases execute the described original chain with no helper interception. Flags 116=1 disable the sample-filter dispatcher; the original constant-zero helper retains query status zero, the 5920 path computes capped-sample minus zero baseline, and valid initial rows reach original 5BA2/5A0A. Invalid rows retain their item/aggregate state and return the expected status bit. Cap/difference writes, type-6 flags, call sequence, R0 and SP assertions pass.

The isolated replay matches candidate JSON byte for byte. I also added an independent assertion on the unchanged validity byte row+122; it passed for all applicable fixtures. Original source and receipt-listed artifact hashes match.

limitations: Only the listed indices, enable/type/validity values and zero status are covered.

No canonical admission or C implementation.
